LanguageData.AR_Rescue_Description:
Rumors speak of a man of noble blood, held fast by dark hands. He is called Aragorn. If this be true, he must not be left to perish in shadow.
Find his prison on the world map. Defeat the Profaned who guard him and bring him home.
LanguageData.AR_Rescue_ArrivalBody: The trail leads to a Profaned stronghold. Go forth and free the heir.
LanguageData.AR_Rescue_Encounter: Aragorn is held here. Defeat his {0} Profaned guards.
LanguageData.AR_Rescue_Success: Aragorn is free, and has joined your people.
LanguageData.AR_Forge_Description:
The shards of an ancient sword await the fire once more. In the halls of the Divine Order, a smith yet keeps the old craft. Guard the forge and endure until the blade is made whole again.
Aragorn must stand before the forge for six in-game hours. Seven Profaned waves arrive about every 51 in-game minutes of active forging. If Aragorn leaves his post, both work and incoming waves pause. When Andúril is complete, take the blade and withdraw.

LanguageData.AR_Forge_ArrivalBody: The forge of the Divine Order has been found. Bring Aragorn there, and let the work begin.

LanguageData.AR_Forge_Ready: The smith awaits. Select Aragorn and speak with the master at the forge.

LanguageData.AR_Forge_FinishedBody: From the shards of Narsil, Andúril has arisen. Aragorn bears the blade once more, and the oathbound spirits may now answer his call. Gather the survivors and leave the golden forge while you still can.

LanguageData.AR_Forge_GuardDesc: Take Aragorn to his place before the forge. The Divine Order smith will reforge Andúril as your companions withstand the Profaned.

LanguageData.AR_Trial_Description:
Beneath stone and silence lingers one of the oathbreakers of old. Only Aragorn, bearer of Andúril, may bring the spirit to heel and bind it once more to service.
Travel to the marked crypt with Aragorn. Defeat the cursed spirit and its Profaned guard to release the next soul.

LanguageData.AR_Trial_GizmoDesc: Discover the next of six class trials. Each quest unlocks every spirit of its class together.

LanguageData.AR_Gizmo_StormDesc: Call down five bolts of spectral fire. Each ignores armor; set its Burn damage in the mod settings. Range: 15 cells; impact area: 6 cells. Only hostile pawns take damage.

LanguageData.AR_Class_ArrivalBody: Class trial {0}/6: {1}. Bring Aragorn to the marked site and complete its unique objective.
LanguageData.AR_Class_Description0: The swordsmen await deep under a mountain. Enter the profaned crypt, defeat scattered undead patrols, and open three sealed graves. One ghost rises from each tomb. Defeat all three to release the entire swordsman class.
LanguageData.AR_Class_Description1: Three spectral archers hold separate fortified firing platforms, surrounded by numerous Profaned bowmen. Break the central oath seal, then defeat all three ghosts and the defenders to unlock the entire archer class.
LanguageData.AR_Class_Description2: Two spectral bombardiers and numerous Profaned curse-mages protect a ritual site. Break both seals. As long as one remains, magical lightning threatens your colonists. Defeat the wardens and both ghosts to free the bombardiers.
LanguageData.AR_Class_Description3: A grand temple filled with ghouls and heavy undead guards the two axe spirits. Clear the temple first. Then send exactly one colonist into the dueling circle to challenge each axe spirit in sequence. Spectators cannot harm the opponent.
LanguageData.AR_Class_Description4: Two cursed captains defend a fortress. Elite Profaned reinforcements arrive in three separate waves. Defeat every wave and both captains to release the two commanders together.
LanguageData.AR_Class_Description5: The final trial takes place in the throne room of the King of the Dead. Elite Profaned guard him. Three oath seals protect the king from all damage. Lightning keeps striking throughout the fight. Break the seals, survive the storm, and defeat the king.
